partially_covered.missing: Organization only has name and address; lacks other typical business attributes (e.g., tax ID, contact info, registration number, etc.)

cq_coverage.details: All CQs except CQ5 are fully supported by classes and properties in the ontology. CQ5, about organization information, is only partially covered due to minimal organization attributes. No new CQs are left uncovered and coverage is unchanged from the previous iteration.

strengths: Good use of reification for organization-role-invoice pattern
Consistent use of property characteristics and inverses
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalence axioms for key concepts

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7 (Missing domain or range in some cases)
P14 (Lack of equivalence axioms for defined concepts)
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet may warn on the use of multiple functional properties per class (e.g., InvoiceParticipation)
Complexity of restrictions may slow reasoning

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Enhance Organization with additional data properties (e.g., tax ID, email, phone, registration number) to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables complete queries about organization details and achieves full CQ coverage.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) or owl:equivalentClass for key roles (e.g., Buyer, Seller) based on the participation pattern.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves reasoning and supports advanced queries about organization roles.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand class hierarchy by defining subclasses for OrganizationRole (BuyerRole, SellerRole) and Item (Product, Service).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increases hierarchy depth and semantic expressivity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:disjointUnionOf for roles or item types where appropriate.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduces ambiguity and clarifies model semantics.
